# NutriScan

> Mobile-first PWA that reads nutrition labels from a photo and turns them into a daily food log, macro tracker and trends, with an AI assistant that knows your log.

NutriScan is a logged-in web app, not a content site. There is one public page ("/"), which is the app itself (Google sign-in or magic link). Live app: https://nutritional-tracker-delta.vercel.app

## What it does
- Scan: photograph a nutrition label, get per-100g and per-serving values extracted by a vision model, edit and save.
- Library: folders of saved foods and reusable meal templates.
- Tracker: daily log against calorie / protein / carb / fat / fibre goals.
- Trends: weekly and monthly averages.
- AI: chat assistant grounded in your own log.

## Stack
FastAPI + Postgres (row-level security) on the backend, React/Vite PWA on the frontend, Supabase auth.

## Source
